script.base: Market prices DAL to lead at home in a dome shootout lean: implied totals about DAL 31 / ARI 23.5 off -7.5 and 54.5. Dak and the DAL skill group start fast, Javonte Williams (48 carries, 241 rush yards over weeks 5-7) keeps the clock honest, and ARI trails but stays in a high-total game so Jacoby Brissett keeps throwing to Trey McBride rather than a pure blowout. Pace stays up because both defenses have allowed 23 passes of 20+ yards.
script.flip1: DAL is up two scores by halftime and runs the clock. Javonte's carries rise, George Pickens and CeeDee Lamb targets stall in the second half (same shape as a favorite pass-yard stall), and ARI abandons the run so Allgeier/Knight/Love rush lines die while McBride/Wilson/Bourne targets spike in catch-up.
script.flip2: ARI hangs around or leads early behind a short DAL week (5 days rest vs ARI 7). Both QBs stay in a 54.5 script, Pickens and McBride both clear, and correlated receiver overs cash together. A slog is the lesser flip: it needs turnovers the pack does not show as a modeled edge, against two explosive-prone defenses.

matchup.pressure: DAL blitzes 26%, which matters because Brissett is poor when blitzed (EPA/dropback -0.25 on 83 dropbacks) and only slightly positive with no blitz (+0.08). A low blitz rate keeps ARI's quick/middle game alive and does not force a check-down spike by itself. ARI blitzes 31%; Dak is fine vs pressure (EPA +0.02 on 97 blitz dropbacks) and better when not blitzed (+0.21), so ARI pressure is not a deep-yard killer for Pickens. DAL also allows 4.92 rush YPC and 24 runs of 10+ in 7 games, plus 23 passes of 20+ on 224 attempts. ARI has no clean side: 8.51 left (76), 8.34 middle (47), 8.55 right (78), 23 explosives on 218 attempts, and 4.73 rush YPC with 22 runs of 10+.
matchup.overlap: McBride is ARI's primary option (32 targets, 230 yards, 209 air yards over L3) and a TE/middle target into the only DAL zone that bleeds (middle 10.2 YPA). Pickens is DAL's efficient downfield producer (30 targets, 260 yards, 303 air yards) into an ARI secondary that gives up 8.3-8.6 YPA everywhere and 23 explosives. Lamb has more air (385) but only 153 yards, so he is not the overlap that is actually cashing. edge_players.edge_sentence: Pickens is the Dallas receiver actually turning downfield targets into yards, and Arizona gives up 8.5 YPA on every third of the field plus 23 explosives, so 66 is short of that role in a 54.5 dome game even if Dallas leads.
edge_players.must_be_true: He plays a full snap share with no game-time scratch, Dak stays in the 10-target range he has had (30 targets over weeks 5-7), and the game does not become a pure second-half clock kill. Indoor roof holds so wind is not a factor.
edge_players.kills_it: Dallas is up big by halftime and runs Javonte; Pickens sees about four targets and finishes in the 40s. Also dies if the 260 L3 yards were one spike game the pack does not split out, or if he is inactive after the pending Friday report.

edge_players.edge_sentence: McBride is Arizona's target leader and he works the middle, the only spot Dallas truly bleeds (10.2 YPA on 41 throws), and a 7.5-point dog in a 54.5 game should keep feeding him around a 73.5 line.
edge_players.must_be_true: He is active and keeps the 10-plus target share (32 targets over L3), Brissett is not blitzed into the -0.25 EPA hole all day (Dallas blitzes only 26%), and Arizona is trailing or in a competitive script rather than a run-heavy tie.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both overs lost because Dallas led 24-6 at half, Javonte Williams pushed 20 carries, and Prescott's attempts died after the break so Pickens finished 4-for-48 under 66. McBride was the covered man: Dallas played the middle closed, Brissett's 26% blitz sample still included two sacks and a strip, and the 32-target role shrank to six looks for 52 yards, with Bourne and the backs taking the cheap completions. The 73.5 number had no cushion, and Pickens' 260-yard L3 was one 140-yard afternoon the pack never split, so the 'role' was never 87 yards a week. Pending inactives could also have removed either player after this read was written.
